schema_description: Resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar for phase2a-analysis-report.json produced by scripts/analyse_phase2_results.py. The file records n_bootstrap explicitly but not the seed or the resampling_unit. The seed defaults to 42 and the resampling unit is tile-level (multi-run averaged over K detection passes).
registry_commit_note: Sidecar written at repository HEAD e038bfe8 on 2026-04-20. The phase2 analysis scripts' defaults have been stable since February 2026.

bootstrap.resampling_unit_note: Tile-level bootstrap, with metrics averaged across K detection passes per tile before CI computation. See scripts/lib_advanced_metrics.py::bootstrap_ci for the tile-level resampler.

notes: Phase 2a cross-modality analysis (N=5 conditions, K=10 passes). Uses the same script family as all subsequent phase2*-analysis.json files. The seed is NOT written into the file; script default seed=42 applies.
